call_purpose: Your new leads from your funnel form had stopped reaching your CRM about three days ago.

resolved.text: Following our guidance, you corrected the webhook URL and saved it, then submitted a test lead and confirmed it now shows up in your CRM, and new leads are flowing again.

covered.text: We found a typo in the webhook URL in your webhook settings.

support_next_steps.text: We will arrange for the missed leads from the last three days to be resent to your CRM, and we will message you once that is done.
